This block initializes the OpenAI chat model that will be used to generate responses based on the context and queries provided. It is a key component of the RAG system, enabling the generation of human-like responses.

Components:
- ChatOpenAI_import: Imports the ChatOpenAI class from the langchain_openai library, which is used to create an instance of the OpenAI chat model.
- openai_chat_model_initialization: Initializes an instance of the ChatOpenAI class with the specified model, creating a chat model that can generate responses based on user queries.
